general.abstract: The forest in the Mazia-Matsch Valley is predominantly made up of European larch and Swiss stone pine. Several units have been installed to measure sap flow in the stems and to monitor tree growth using automatic dendrometers. The data collected are used to investigate the influence of climate factors on the common coniferous species in the area.
